issues.title: [dkblinux98/nyxGPT] fix: make yamllint line-length a warning so security hooks stay armed (PR #4013)
findings: The committed comment records falsified measurements, and AC4's sweep was never reported
Same comment: "Every other yamllint rule (syntax, truthy, indentation, ...) still errors and still blocks" — `truthy` does not

The PR body's "visible to anyone adding one" oversells: pre-commit hides a *passing* hook's output by default, so line-length warnings will not normally be seen at commit time. Adding `verbose: true` to the hook would make them visible; optional, and the trade (noise on every YAML commit) is a judgment call — not blocking.

`CONTRIBUTING.md:144-147` describes the yamllint style rules; a parenthetical that the 120 limit reports as a warning (while other rules block) would keep it precise. Also pre-existing and untouched by this PR: `CONTRIBUTING.md:58-61,82-89` still list black/ruff/mypy as pre-commit hooks, which were moved to CI-only on 2026-08-18 per `AGENTS.md` — worth its own cleanup, not this PR's falsification.
No ledger entry for the owner reversal. Acceptable as-is: the decision is recorded in the guard's own comment, which is the doctrine-preferred location; an entry riding along would also be fine.
`truthy` still falsely listed among rules that "still error and still block"
The PR body still says "reflowing those 63 lines" in its restore-path paragraph; the tree is corrected but the body was not. Not merged content — worth a one-line edit for the record, not blocking.

`CONTRIBUTING.md:147` ("Truthy values: `true`/`false` or `yes`/`no`") is pre-existing prose this PR does not touch and does not falsify — but `yes`/`no` are precisely what the truthy rule warns about, so the line was already wrong before this PR. Worth folding into the existing CONTRIBUTING cleanup noted last round; not blocking.

Issue #4008's AC5 (a CI guard so yamllint debt cannot silently return) remains unimplemented as written; under the owner-approved config approach the forced-bypass mechanism is removed for the one rule with debt, and a new error-level violation fails loudly at the introducing commit, so the criterion's motivation is substantially dissolved. Noted for the owner's acceptance pass; consistent with the previous round, not blocking.
